name: JL-002
primary_comparison: swarm versus sequential on the 64 distinct clean base scenarios
secondary_comparisons: all 96 cases, single baseline, each family, matched note-only injection effects
interpretation: The four-case threshold is a predeclared practical descriptive screen, not statistical significance. Report wins/losses even when screen fails. Ties and negative findings retained. No tuning, retries, replacement cases or automatic follow-up.
resource_matching: swarm and sequential each four requests, same checklists, same synthesis, same original evidence. Only prior-judgment visibility differs. Actual tokens and cost are measured and may differ. Single uses one request.
limitations: non-blind; deterministic author-visible fixtures; four shared policy families; 32 correlated twins; no population-level significance or emergent-intelligence claim
